T-014: sequential and 6-way concurrent re-delivery stores one byte-identical row; a conflicting duplicate is rejected and never overwrites; out-of-order samples keep their own source time and fill tracked gaps; after asset revision + recalibration, an out-of-order earlier sample is pinned to the old assignment/asset/channel/calibration revisions while a new one gets the new revisions and offset, the pre-rebind row is unchanged and the health basis does not move backwards; a rebind after a future-skewed sample starts after it; the database refuses to end an interval under bound telemetry; samples reject UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE.

T-015: never-reported channels are OFFLINE NO_LIVE_TELEMETRY; with an advancing clock reads go FRESH -> STALE -> OFFLINE before any sweep, the sweeper persists each step idempotently with typed telemetry.stale.v1 events; LATE/BACKFILL arrivals never refresh; a new LIVE reading refreshes without backdating; stopped heartbeats move the channel and device rollup to STALE/OFFLINE; device-reported OUT_OF_RANGE, implausible values and unit-mismatched live readings are INVALID with their reason until a newer good LIVE sample; a revoked device is INVALID DEVICE_REVOKED; an unauthenticated request leaves the projection unchanged; the database refuses FRESH without a LIVE flag-free basis and any state outside FRESH/STALE/OFFLINE/INVALID; a rewound evaluation time cannot read or persist FRESH.

T-016: the reference agent disconnected for 12 readings with an 8-slot buffer drops 4 (disclosed with count, sequence/time range and exact aggregates), reconnects, sends live first (LIVE) and drains the rest oldest-first in <=3-message BACKFILL batches under a 4-message/1-per-second gateway budget (429 + Retry-After honoured, nothing lost); stored rows keep original event times, receipt times follow send order, the dropped range is the only outstanding gap and is marked disclosed; re-sending a backfilled message as live is a duplicate and the class stays BACKFILL (UPDATE refused); a 2-minute-late live delivery is LATE; LATE/BACKFILL never qualify for recovery; live data is accepted while the backfill budget is exhausted; the scheduler runs queued live before queued backfill and applies backpressure; simulator samples (and anything from a SIMULATOR-class device or labelled SIMULATED_INPUT) are stored SIMULATED_INPUT and fail assertPhysicalSensorClaim; devices.input_class cannot be changed.

Security review (self, 3db432c): health reads/sweeper evaluate at max(requested, server clock); unauthenticated work is bounded before database access; process-wide metrics are not served on the device listener. Coordinator review (73fdbfd): failure budgets are reserved synchronously before any await and refunded on success (20 concurrent forged tokens -> exactly 3 reach authentication with a budget of 3; 20 concurrent malformed tokens -> exactly 5 with a per-source budget of 5); failures are charged per claimed credential (kid) plus a coarse per-source cap; a token verified in memory against a credential the gateway already authenticated (TTL cache, unseen jti) spends no budget, so an attacker exhausting both budgets from the same address does not stop the targeted device or its neighbour from having readings accepted; trustProxy is explicit configuration (default false).

specAmbiguitiesResolved: ADR 0001 §4: transport is signed HTTPS; MQTT is UNSUPPORTED here. Device identity = M02's single-use HS256 device token; body integrity = HMAC-SHA256 with a key HKDF-derived from the same device credential (label ub-telemetry-body-signature.v1) plus a ±300 s signing-time bound.
Wire channel references are sensor channel ids (chn_…) owned by the authenticated device (sensor_channels has no human key); asset, tenant, revision and class claims are not in the schema at all.

Dedupe key is DATA-MODEL's (tenant, channel, boot_id, sequence); one device message carries one sequence shared by its channel samples. Sample digests cover only the device's claim, so a re-send under a different delivery mode is a DUPLICATE and keeps the stored class.

Lateness policy telemetry-lateness.v1 (code-versioned, digest pinned on every sample): BACKFILL delivery -> BACKFILL; live delivery lag <= 30 s LIVE, <= 10 min LATE, else BACKFILL; lead > 5 s FUTURE_EVENT_TIME; older than 7 d rejected. Freshness policy telemetry-freshness.v1 (pinned on each projection): STALE after 120 s, OFFLINE after 600 s from the newest LIVE flag-free source time. Tenant-configurable policies need a new M02 policy key (not added).

Freshness is per sensor channel (device health = worst channel); FRESH requires a LIVE flag-free basis; quality flags, live-lag binding/unit rejections and future timestamps make the channel INVALID until a newer good LIVE sample; revoked device or retired channel is INVALID. devices.status (registry lifecycle) is not driven by telemetry.

'Superseded binding' = the assignment effective at source time names an asset revision already superseded at that time (only reachable by direct writes, since the repository rebinds). 'Overlapping' cannot be created through the schema (exclusion constraints); the gateway still rejects it and T-013 proves it with the constraint dropped in a throwaway database.

Sequence gaps are recorded only after the first observed sequence of a boot; outstanding ranges subtract later arrivals and rejected sequences; 'disclosed' means every outstanding range is covered by an edge drop disclosure.
FR-22 simulator labelling is server-enforced: a SIMULATOR-class device's samples are always SIMULATED_INPUT; a sample label can only downgrade a physical device's sample.
Implausible values (temperature outside -100..150 °C, etc.) are stored with OUT_OF_RANGE for diagnosis rather than rejected; contract violations (below absolute zero, door not 0/1) are rejected.
Health reads and the sweeper evaluate at max(requested time, server clock) so callers cannot rewind freshness; tests drive a ManualClock that never runs behind real time.

Telemetry is not time-partitioned (DATA-MODEL suggests it); indexes on (tenant, channel, event_at), (tenant, device, boot, sequence) and per-binding columns instead. Successful ingests are not written to audit_entries (the batch/sample/rejection rows are the record); denials are.
unresolvedRisks: Real sensor path, MQTT adapter, credential rotation with bounded overlap and firmware acceptance (HARDWARE-IOT §4, §11) are NOT_RUN/UNSUPPORTED.

Rate budgets, scheduler queues, failure budgets and the known-credential cache are per gateway process (in memory); multi-instance deployments need shared budgets or sticky routing. A device whose credential is not yet known to this process (cold start, cache TTL 10 min, key rotation) can still be delayed by 429 while an attacker at the same address holds the per-source budget or forges its kid; a rotated key is recognised again after its first successful authentication. trustProxy defaults to false and must be set explicitly behind a proxy.
The machine-token jti cache (principal_token_uses) is still never pruned (M02 residual); every device request adds a row.
listSequenceGaps issues two queries per gap (bounded to 1000 gaps) and is not cursor-paginated; listTelemetrySamples has a keyset cursor (after) capped at 5000 rows.
Ingest work per request is bounded (<=200 messages x 16 samples) but per-sample queries are not batched; NFR-08 latency targets are unmeasured.
Calibration records beyond calibration_revision/offset (reference method, curve, evidence digest, HARDWARE-IOT §7) are not modelled.
process-wide metrics() is only in-process; no authenticated operations listener exists yet (M13).

The gateway keeps device credential keys in process memory (bounded, TTL) to recognise valid credentials before spending failure budgets; revocation and single-use jti remain enforced in the database on every request.

truthStatement: M03 completed and locally verified signed HTTPS telemetry ingestion, revision-pinned immutable samples, freshness projection and a simulator-labelled reference edge agent against a local PostgreSQL 17 container; no physical sensor, MQTT broker, deployment, provider, Kite payment or recovery evidence exists, and all of it remains NOT_RUN.
